care.metaTitle: Quartz care guidance | QJ Quartz Stone
care.metaDescription: How to clean and care for your QJ quartz surface.
title: EASY TO LIVE WITH.
EASY TO LOOK AFTER.
care.copy: QJ quartz is made for everyday life, and caring for it is simple.

items.title: Everyday cleaning
items.body: Wipe with mild soap and warm water. That is all a QJ surface needs from day to day.

items.title: No sealing
items.body: QJ quartz requires no sealing when cut, and no conditioning or polishing.

items.title: Heat and stains
items.body: QJ surfaces are heat and stain resistant. They pass the ANSI Z124.6.5.2 stain test and boiling water has no effect under NEMA LD3 2000 3.5.

items.title: Hygiene
items.body: QJ stones contain anti-bacterial enhancements, and showed no fungal or bacterial growth under ASTM G 21.

draftItems: Wipe up spills promptly rather than letting them dry.
Use trivets and hot pads under pans straight from the stove or oven.
Use a chopping board rather than cutting directly on the surface.
Avoid harsh chemicals such as paint removers, oven cleaners and bleach.

faq.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about QJ quartz surfaces, sizes, care and samples.
title: GOOD QUESTIONS.
CLEAR ANSWERS.
faq.copy: The questions we hear most often.

items.q: What is QJ quartz made of?
items.a: Quartz in an array of mesh sizes, along with recycled material, is combined with resin and high density pigments, then vacuumed, vibrated and compressed into a slab.
Standard slabs are 3200 × 1600 mm in 12, 20 and 30 mm thicknesses. 20 and 30 mm can also be cut to a designated size.
No. QJ quartz requires no sealing when cut, and no conditioning or polishing.
Just wipe with mild soap and warm water.
QJ quartz has a published water absorption of less than 0.011% under ASTM D 570.
Yes. QJ products come with a 10 year manufacturer’s guarantee.
QJ quartz surfaces are produced in Sri Lanka and Taiwan.
QJ quartz is used for kitchen tops, table tops, floors, bathrooms, pools and living rooms.

items.q: Can I see a sample first?
items.a: Yes, and we recommend it. Request a sample online or book a consultation.
Yes. Regional distributors assist customers in their markets, and new enquiries are welcome through our Manufacturing & Export page.

manufacturing.label: Manufacturing & export
title: ARTISTRY
MEETS TECHNOLOGY.
manufacturing.copy: From raw quartz to finished surface, QJ follows the whole supply chain through a fully vertically integrated business model.
manufacturing.partners: Queens Ceramic Inc. has been a pioneering force in building materials for decades. Jaysons Holdings (Pvt) Ltd is a market leader in luxury housing and interiors, property development, hospitality and mineral trading. Together they are QJ Quartz Stone.

steps.title: Sourcing the quartz
steps.body: Quartz is the most important factor in a quartz surface. QJ sources it from around the world, inspects mining sites itself, and has its own mine and technology to control particle size, whiteness and brightness.

steps.title: Forming the slab
steps.body: Quartz in an array of mesh sizes, along with recycled material, is combined with resin and high density pigments. The compound is spread into a customised cast iron mould, then vacuumed, vibrated and compressed.

steps.title: Polishing and quality control
steps.body: The compressed slab is baked at 80–100 °C, then sent through a diamond-edged polisher. Polished slabs are inspected inch by inch for defects before they are passed for the market.

steps.title: Water recycling
steps.body: QJ strives to preserve and protect the environment, with a state of the art water recycling plant that purifies the water used for polishing and cleaning.
